title: Food waste
statement: Homes, canteens and shops throw away huge amounts of good food every day.

title: Water shortage
statement: People waste water they don't know they're wasting, and many places run short.

title: Student stress
statement: Students feel overloaded and don't know where to get help.

title: Road safety
statement: Two-wheeler riders and pedestrians get hurt on busy roads every day.

title: Elderly living alone
statement: Older people living alone need safety and company without moving out.

title: Small shopkeepers
statement: Local shops struggle to track stock, customers and sales.

title: Waste and recycling
statement: Households mix up their waste, so recycling rarely works.

title: Disaster readiness
statement: Floods and storms hit with too little warning, and people don't know what to do.
